parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Chilliwack · Promontory
Promontory is an MLS® sub-area name in the City of Chilliwack. The City doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The City describes Jinkerson Park as located in the Promontory neighbourhood, and the South Vedder Neighbourhood Plan area is bordered by the Promontory neighbourhood to the southeast.
As a rough guide, it is the hillside area east of Vedder Road, above the Vedder and Sardis flats, with Promontory Road as its main road. That is an orientation, not a City boundary.

Planning, zoning and flood

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for Promontory

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.
Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500 (Chilliwack 2050) was adopted on December 16, 2025. It covers the whole city, including Promontory.

Promontory is one of the designated hillside and upland areas where a Development Permit Area 2 (DPA2) permit is required before subdivision, construction, land clearing or earthworks. The City’s DPA2 guide shows these areas on OCP Schedule E, Map 14.
Under the previous 2040 OCP, growth was directed to designated hillsides governed by Comprehensive Development Area Plans, including Promontory. That plan has been replaced by Chilliwack 2050.
A Promontory Development Plan from 1994 is mentioned in sources that are not City pages. Always verify exact boundaries directly on the City of Chilliwack Webmap.

The South Vedder Neighbourhood Plan covers the adjacent area. Council adopted it in 2022 and it was updated in 2025 with the Official Community Plan. It borders the Promontory neighbourhood to the southeast.
ALR: Published municipal records list no ALR land in Promontory in published municipal planning documents. ALR status is set address by address.
Slope: the City’s DPA2 guide says the objectives include reducing slope hazards, erosion and flooding, and making sure development responds to the natural terrain and drainage patterns.

A DPA2 application requires a geotechnical report by a registered geotechnical engineer, covering the hazard and slope assessment, setbacks and cut and fill, site stability, and drainage and soil conditions. An environmental assessment and a hydrology report may also be required.

Flood: the City’s floodplain bylaw guide says much of Chilliwack lies in the floodplain of the Fraser, Vedder or Sumas rivers or of one of several creeks entering the valley from hillside areas. The Floodplain Regulation Bylaw, No. 4519, regulates construction in the floodplain. Whether a lot is in a floodplain is a lot-by-lot question.

Where is Promontory?
Promontory is an MLS® sub-area name. The City doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The City describes Jinkerson Park as located in the Promontory neighbourhood, and the South Vedder Neighbourhood Plan area is bordered by the Promontory neighbourhood to the southeast.
That is an orientation from addresses, not a City boundary, so ask me if a specific address is in it.
How do I get around from Promontory?

BC Transit route 54 Promontory runs between Cottonwood Mall and Promontory, via Vedder Rd, Promontory Rd, Teskey Way and Sylvan Dr. Timing points include Vedder and Promontory, Teskey and Promontory, and Sylvan and Vista.
The Rider’s Guide shows route 54 service on weekdays, Saturdays and Sundays.
Published municipal records do not list new or planned bus lines for Promontory.
See the
route 54 page
Which school is in Promontory?
Promontory Heights Elementary Community School (kindergarten to grade 5) is at 46200 Stoneview Dr.
SD33’s Families of Schools list puts it in the G.W. Graham Secondary family.
Middle school feeder boundaries depend on your exact street address, because catchment boundaries vary by street address. Check an exact address with the
SD33 School Locator
What parks and library are near Promontory?
Jinkerson Park, at 5869 Jinkerson Rd, has a pump track, a multi-use games area, playgrounds and off-leash dog areas. Mount Thom Park is a 70-hectare wooded park with trails from the Promontory side.
The nearest library is the Sardis Library at 5819 Tyson Road. No library branch is in Promontory itself.
What plans and rules cover Promontory?
Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500 (Chilliwack 2050) covers the whole city.
Promontory is a designated hillside and upland area where a DPA2 permit is required before subdivision, construction, land clearing or earthworks.
How does the hillside affect building in Promontory?

A DPA2 application requires a geotechnical report by a registered geotechnical engineer, covering the hazard and slope assessment, setbacks and cut and fill, site stability, and drainage and soil conditions.
